question: A, B and C together can complete a certain work in 54 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 56 days. B is 75% more efficient than A. A, B and C work together for 52 days. B alone will complete the remaining work in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ A = (A+B+C) − (B+C) = 1/54 − 1/56 = 1/1512

⇒ B = 75% more efficient ⇒ B = 7/4 × A = 1/864

⇒ Take LCM = 6048 ⇒ (A,B,C) = (4,7,101)

⇒ 52 days work = 52 × 112 = 5824 ⇒ Remaining = 224

⇒ Time by B = 224 ÷ 7 = 32 days

**∴ Answer = 32 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A+B+C = 54 days, B+C = 56 days

**Formula:**

Work Rate = 1 / Days

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 1/54 − 1/56 = (56 − 54)/(54 × 56) = 1/1512

⇒ B = 75% more efficient than A ⇒ B = 7/4 × 1/1512 = 1/864

⇒ C = 1/56 − 1/864 = 101/6048

⇒ LCM = 6048
